description: This Java source file defines an abstract utility class 'ImageLoader' used for asynchronously loading and caching images in an Android application. It manages in-memory and disk caching, background processing, placeholder images, and fade-in effects for image loading in 'ImageView' widgets. The class includes internal classes for asynchronous task handling, drawable management, and bitmap decoding with sampling.

classes.name: ImageLoader
classes.description: An abstract class for asynchronous image loading with caching and processing capabilities. Handles background tasks, cache management, placeholder images, and fade-in animations.

classes.name: AsyncDrawable
classes.description: A Drawable subclass that holds a weak reference to the associated background image loading task to prevent redundant work and facilitate cancellation.

classes.name: BitmapWorkerTask
classes.description: An internal AsyncTask subclass responsible for background image processing, caching, and updating UI upon completion.

methods.name: loadImage
methods.description: Begins the process of asynchronously loading an image into an ImageView, utilizing cache if available or starting a background task otherwise.

methods.name: setLoadingImage
methods.description: Sets the placeholder bitmap shown while the actual image is being loaded.

methods.name: addImageCache
methods.description: Attaches an in-memory cache to the image loader, maintaining cache across configuration changes.

methods.name: setImageFadeIn
methods.description: Enables or disables fade-in transition when images are loaded.

methods.name: setPauseWork
methods.description: Pauses or resumes background work, useful during list scrolling or other UI interactions.

methods.name: decodeSampledBitmapFromDescriptor
methods.description: Decodes a bitmap from a FileDescriptor, sampling down the image to reduce memory consumption.

methods.name: calculateInSampleSize
methods.description: Calculates an appropriate sampling factor for downsampling a bitmap to close to the requested dimensions.
